baseline_prompt_en: An unmistakably adult woman conservation scientist works inside a partially flooded Baroque archive, aligning a vellum leaf beneath a raised glass platen while shallow water mirrors gilded shelves and a chandelier-like pulley drying rack. Her appearance draws only general adult visual cues from the supplied appearance reference; the designed face geometry takes priority over its outline. Frame a restrained frontal three-quarter waist-up portrait with both sides of the facial outline fully visible. Hair is pinned completely away from the temples, cheekbones, jaw corners, and chin. Build a diamond-shaped facial outline through temples narrower than the zygomatic span, cheekbones as the widest bilateral points, jaw corners tapering inward below them, and a narrow pointed chin completing the lower contour. Her expression is neutral as one gloved hand aligns the vellum leaf and the other steadies a humidity sensor. Soft face-shaping light and low-distortion portrait perspective preserve contour evidence amid reflected candles, ornate stucco, catalog ribbons, and conservation tools.
